title: Full faithfulness of the affine structure-algebra functor
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F$ be a functor from the opposite of the category of schemes affine over $S$ [pqf-def-affine-morphism] to quasi-coherent sheaves of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf, pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose its value on each $f:X\to S$ is $f_*\mathcal O_X$, and on every $S$-morphism $h:X\to Y$ its components are the section maps $h^\sharp$ (transported along the specified object equalities). Then $F$ is full and faithful.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01SA; Constructions, Lemmas 01LT and 01LY; the local argument of original step 6

proof.text: Faithfulness is proved directly: use hmap and cancel the object transports to equate section maps on affine U. Restrict the two scheme maps to g inverse image U, which is affine by [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Injectivity of the Gamma-Spec correspondence [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme] equates the restrictions; uniqueness on the inverse-image open cover [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] equates the maps. The Lean helper affine_over_ext needs only affineness of the target map.

For fullness, transport the given F-morphism using hobj to an algebra morphism alpha. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-affine-algebra-local-maps] to get compatible local maps. Glue them on the inverse images of all affine opens using [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing]. Check the composite to S on the same cover, obtaining an Over S morphism. Compute its section map from the local formula using the gluing restriction identity, comp_appLE, and cancellation of the canonical top-section isomorphism. By hmap its F-image has the original components on every affine open, after cancelling the object transports. Equality on the affine basis [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-morphism-on-basis] gives equality of algebra morphisms, hence fullness.
